identity.mission: Create a premium, serious B2B enterprise aesthetic that breaks the 'AI Slop' convention. Dark, electric, and emotionally directed.

rules: DO NOT use Inter for headings.
Headings (Syne): Use weights 700 or 800 for impact. Tight tracking (-0.02em).
Body (Manrope): Use weights 400 or 500. Relaxed leading (1.6).

usage: Background: Void Black (#050505) - Never pure black #000000.
Gradients: Use subtle 'glow' gradients, not full background gradients.

containers.card_style: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-8 hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors duration-300

buttons.primary: bg-[#0066FF] text-white hover:bg-[#0052CC] rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-semibold shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,102,255,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(0,102,255,0.5)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10 rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-medium backdrop-blur-sm transition-all

cards.feature: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-white/5 p-8 border border-white/10 hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-500
cards.tracing_beam: Use a moving gradient border effect for high-value cards.

inputs.style: bg-white/5 border-white/10 text-white placeholder:text-gray-500 focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-xl h-12

visual_enhancers.noise: Add a subtle noise texture overlay with opacity-5 pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-50
visual_enhancers.glows: Use radial gradients with blur-3xl opacity-20 to create atmospheric lighting behind sections.

hero_background.alt: Abstract blue neon data network visualization
hero_background.usage: Hero section background with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/80)

about_section.usage: About Us section, perhaps with a gradient fade

motion.reveal: Staggered fade-up animations for all text and cards (y: 20 -> 0, opacity: 0 -> 1).
motion.hover: Scale up (1.02) on cards, glow intensification on buttons.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is WCAG AA compliant. Use text-gray-300 for secondary text, not darker.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-primary) for keyboard navigation.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL DEPENDENCIES: npm install @fontsource/syne @fontsource/manrope framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge
2. SETUP FONTS: Import fonts in index.css or App.js.
3. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the colors and fonts defined above.
4. BUILD LAYOUT: Use the 'Tetris' grid for the Features section.
5. IMPLEMENT HERO: Use the abstract background image with a strong gradient overlay. Center the 'Book a Call' CTA.
6. USE SHADCN: Use Shadcn components for the Booking Form (Calendar, Dialog, Input) but style them to match the Dark/Electric theme.
7. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop' - no generic gradients or centered layouts without tension.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns/headers without blur.
